control: Record customer, tenant, durable endpoint identity, technician, ticket, reason, scope, mode, and authority
evidence_to_capture: Ticket; tenant and device IDs; approver; scope

control: Capture the failed attempt before retrying
evidence_to_capture: Timestamp and zone; session ID; first error; duration; screenshots

control: Verify technician identity, MFA, role, entitlement, and device scope
evidence_to_capture: Identity and role export; MFA evidence; policy result

control: Define success, stop condition, privacy boundary, rollback, and escalation
evidence_to_capture: Approved test plan; rollback; escalation owner

control: Confirm power, network, tenant placement, and current check-in
evidence_to_capture: Current telemetry; network and tenant evidence

control: Compare last check-in, inventory, boot, user session, and agent version
evidence_to_capture: Affected and known-good comparison

control: Verify agent and remote-support components are healthy
evidence_to_capture: Service status; versions; crash and update history

control: Review the first local event during the failed attempt
evidence_to_capture: OS; service; application; installer; agent logs

control: Resolve documented service hostnames from the endpoint
evidence_to_capture: DNS answers; resolver; captive portal or sinkhole checks

control: Test documented outbound ports through the actual service path
evidence_to_capture: Firewall; proxy; VPN; filter; egress test evidence

control: Verify time, certificate chain, revocation, TLS, proxy, and inspection
evidence_to_capture: Clock; chain; TLS result; proxy and inspection logs

control: Check vendor and tenant broker, relay, region, queue, and license health
evidence_to_capture: Status page; region; incident or support request ID

control: Locate the failed stage in the session lifecycle
evidence_to_capture: Launch; broker; acknowledgement; consent; transport; capture stage

control: Classify disconnect timing and trigger
evidence_to_capture: Elapsed time; policy; relay; sleep; service; network events

control: Investigate black or blank screen evidence
evidence_to_capture: User session; display driver; GPU; secure desktop; privacy mode

control: Use one approved alternate technician path for comparison
evidence_to_capture: Approved alternate client or network result

control: Correct only the verified dependency
evidence_to_capture: Before state; exact correction; approval; after state

control: Change one variable and retain rollback evidence
evidence_to_capture: Change record; actor; timestamps; rollback result

control: Reject broad or persistent security workarounds
evidence_to_capture: Documented rejected workaround and safer alternative

control: Repair or reinstall only with identity and log preservation
evidence_to_capture: Backup evidence; documented procedure; post-repair identity

control: Run one bounded authorized connection retest
evidence_to_capture: Fresh session and audit IDs; consent; timing; termination

control: Test only authorized session capabilities
evidence_to_capture: Scoped keyboard; pointer; display; transfer; elevation results

control: Verify post-session endpoint and control health
evidence_to_capture: Agent; service; telemetry; alerts; network; security state

control: Record root cause, cohort, prevention, residual risk, and ownership
evidence_to_capture: Closure record; cohort reconciliation; owner and review date
